text:
Tess: Quick heads-up before we go live  - need to swap the demo and roadmap order. Demo should come after roadmap to avoid overlap with the live demo network call.
Marco: Copy that. I'll flip the presenter order in Slides and tag the new deck. Won't take more than 30s.
Ivy: Ops: rehearsal showed a 35s gap when we switched scenes on OBS. Starting a hot fallback recorder and switching ingest to standby-node now.
StreamOpsBot: ingest switched to standby-node-5 :white_check_mark: 
Ivy: Running local recorder: recctl start --sess ah-0326-hotfix --out /tmp/rec/ah-0326-fallback.mp4 --mode rolling
RecorderBot: Fallback recording started (id: rec-3287-1)
Tess: Also let's add a 20s buffer after the roadmap so captions can resync. Last run captions drifted when presenters overlapped.
Marco: Done. Slide 1 note updated: "Roadmap -> 20s buffer -> Demo". New deck uploaded: https://drive/redwood/allhands/ah-0326-v5.pptx
Ivy: Checking encoder metrics now  encoder stable, no frame drops in last 2 mins. Keeping fallback recorder until upload completes.
Tess: For Q&A, call out pricing/commit flexibility and Dedicated autoscaler timeline. We'll take top 4 live.
Mia (CEO): Good call. We'll mention Dedicated autoscaler as "in design (Q2)" and hold ~7 minutes for pricing. @Product please have the PM ready for commit questions.
Marco: Who's moderating Qs? I can surface top ones but need someone to triage live chat.
Tess: I'll moderate and forward top 4 to Mia. Ivy, can you make sure the trimmed highlight clip gets uploaded quickly after the session?
Ivy: Yep. Creating INF ticket now to attach raw + trimmed clip after upload. INF-942 will track it.
RecorderBot: Upload queued, will attach to INF-942 when complete.
Marco: Ready to go live in 30s. Tess, anything else?
Tess: One more: mic on stage C had a hum in rehearsal. We'll hot-swap to the lav and keep stage audio muted during the slide transition.
Ivy: Mic swap confirmed, levels look good. Audio route set to mesa-backup just in case.
StreamOpsBot: audio-route updated to mesa-backup :white_check_mark: 
Mia (CEO): Appreciate the ops quick reaction. We'll call out the demo reorder in the intro and move into Q&A after the demo with pricing first.
Tess: OK switching to live channel. If anyone sees artifacts, drop here and I'll cut to backup. Good luck everyone.
Marco: Feed looks smooth. Captions re-synced.
Ivy: Recorder upload in progress, ETA ~5 mins post-meeting.
RecorderBot: Upload complete: https://internal-storage/recs/ah-0326-fallback.mp4 :rocket:
Tess: Post-meeting follow-ups: Ivy attach raw + INF-942, Marco export 10m highlight, Product send pricing FAQ to Comms, Mia to take top 4 Qs.
Mia (CEO): Got it. Thanks all.
Tess: Closing thread and monitoring live. :thumbsup:
